name: MarketOps Crawl4AI Cloud Research
name_zh: MarketOps · Crawl4AI 公开网页提取
description: Extract public webpages to Markdown or structured JSON using a user-supplied Crawl4AI Cloud API key; billing-management tools are disabled locally.
description_zh: 使用用户自己的 Crawl4AI Cloud Key 提取公开网页正文与结构化字段；试用版过滤账单管理工具。
description_en: Read public pages and extract structured data with a user-supplied Crawl4AI key. Billing tools are filtered in this client.
examples_zh: 抓取这个公开企业主页并提取业务范围，附原始来源。
读取 2 个已批准的场地网页，提取名称、地区和场地类型。
examples_en: Read this public company page and extract activities with a source link.
Extract venue names and locations from two approved pages.
